records.subject: You're in -- let's get North Media set up
records.body:
Hi Mia,

Welcome to Wrenfield! Your workspace is ready. A good first step is to create your first project and invite a teammate.

If anything's unclear, just reply here.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: New signup alert -- *North Media* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: Account created first project on day 5 (2026-07-14), showing real activity with 8 days left, but no invite sent and no reply to either outreach (email:5a54e057, email:ce3dd526). Single admin, Starter plan, no tickets, so momentum is unproven beyond one step.

draft.subject: Next step after your first project
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Nice work getting your first North Media project created in Wrenfield. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding the first few tasks there is a natural next step.

When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whatever you'd like to set up next.

Best,
Nadia
